title: Nikon Z Mount Expands V-RAPTOR [X], KOMODO-X Camera Systems
text:
exciting News for V-RAPTOR [X] Z MOUNT and KOMODO-X Z MOUNT Shooters In‌ a groundbreaking move, ​RED ‌Digital Cinema has introduced a suite of new adapter packs designed specifically ⁢for teh V-RAPTOR [X] and KOMODO-X cameras with Z Mount . These innovative solutions are set to revolutionize the way filmmakers approach their projects, offering unparalleled versatility⁣ and versatility.
Adapter‍ Pack options Currently,‍ there are four‌ different Z-to-PL Adapter Pack options available:
Red V-RAPTOR [X] Z to PL Adapter Pack – Priced at $1,500, this adapter pack allows‍ seamless integration⁢ between ⁣the ⁢Z Mount and PL Mount ​ systems. Red V-RAPTOR [X] Z to PL with Electronic ND Adapter ⁤Pack – For $3,500, ‌this pack includes an electronic​ neutral density filter, providing enhanced ‌control over exposure and depth of field. Red KOMODO-X⁣ Z to PL Adapter Pack – Also​ priced ‍at $1,500,this adapter ‍pack is tailored for the KOMODO-X camera,offering similar functionality‍ to the V-RAPTOR [X] version. Red KOMODO-X Z to ⁢PL with Electronic ND Adapter Pack – Priced at $3,500, this pack includes the electronic neutral‍ density filter, offering ​advanced control for the KOMODO-X camera. These adapter packs are now available for purchase on RED.com or through Red Premium Dealers, ‍making it easier than ‍ever for filmmakers to upgrade their equipment.
Camera Mount Conversion RED Digital Cinema​ has also introduced a program allowing filmmakers to convert their RF ‍mount versions of the V-RAPTOR ⁤ [X] and KOMODO-X cameras to the new Z⁤ Mount systems. The conversion costs $1,695 for the V-RAPTOR [X] and‍ $1,595 for the KOMODO-X,providing an affordable way to‍ leverage ‌the benefits of the Z Mount technology.
Trade-In Program To further support filmmakers, RED​ has⁤ announced the ⁤return of its⁢ trade-in program. ‌This program now includes the latest generation‌ of Red cameras, including ‍the new Z Mount models. Customers can trade in their existing Red DSMC, RAVEN, SCARLET-W, DSMC2, or RANGER cameras and receive a ⁢credit towards the purchase of a new, eligible‌ red V-RAPTOR ⁣XL [X] Pack or ‍Red V-RAPTOR Pack [X] Pack,⁢ with either the new Z⁢ Mount or RF Mount.
This initiative not only helps filmmakers upgrade their‌ equipment but also promotes sustainability by recycling older models.
Conclusion RED Digital cinema’s latest offerings are a testament to the company’s commitment to innovation ​and‌ supporting the filmmaking community. With these ⁤new adapter packs and conversion options, filmmakers⁣ can ‌now explore new creative possibilities and enhance ⁣their workflows. For more details, visit​ RED’s official ⁤website [[1]].
Stay tuned for ⁤more updates and exciting news from the world ‍of cinema​ technology!
